usedFor: Shopify takes the orders, and Fresh kds shows the kitchen a message through “Send KDS Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Send KDS Message” in Fresh kds
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order reaches the kitchen screens quickly, before staff spend time on it.

watchOut: “Send KDS Message” goes to all devices at a location or selected ones, so pick the devices on purpose.
